posts.title_en: [Leak] Next version: levels, events, dungeons and the rest
posts.summary_en: Client-data leak of version 1.5 by 삥삥. Cookie level cap 100 → 150, with lower Star Candy (cookie EXP) costs for some levels: Lv.1→100 needs 28.56M in total, Lv.100→150 needs 8.33G more, and Lv.150 needs Crumble (account) Lv.350. A table gives, per cookie level 79–150, the Crumble level required, the Star Candy for that level (old → new for 79–100), the cumulative EXP and a 'stat increase' figure (26.5299 at Lv.100, 44.1109 at Lv.120, 93.6233 at Lv.150; unit not given). Daily dungeons grow from 770 to 900 stages; stage 900 of the rune and research stone dungeons recommends 47.82G power and pays 909 Rune Crystals or 1.18M basic research stones per clear. Events: a 7-day check-in from 10-08 giving a Milk cookie on day 7.

datapoints.cost: 251.89M Star Candy (cumulative 28.56M at Lv.100 → 280.45M at Lv.120); Lv.120 needs Crumble Lv.200

datapoints.note: Inferred: Lv.120 carries 1.663× the Lv.100 'stat increase' value (+66%), about +2.6% per level from 101 to 120 (26.5299 → 27.2181 at 101; 43.0107 → 44.1109 at 120). Unit and how it maps to displayed power are not stated; it is not a power figure.

datapoints.account: any (leaked game data, cap 150 not shipped)
datapoints.cost: cumulative 280.45M → 8.36G Star Candy; Lv.150 needs Crumble Lv.350

datapoints.note: New cumulative Lv.1→100 = 28.56M. Crumble level requirement equals cookie level − 3 up to Lv.97, then 96, 98, 100. Stat increase 15.1249 at Lv.79, 20.4032 at Lv.90.

datapoints.cost: stage 891 recommends 43.56G, stage 900 47.82G; rune dungeon 900 pays 909 Rune Crystals per clear; research stone dungeon pays 1.18M basic research stones per clear, first clear 780K or 12 special research stones every 5th stage
datapoints.note: Recommended power (권장 전투력) from screenshots 79865-2, 79865-3.

quotes.en: 1-1. Max level 100 → 150
Lv.1 → 100 needs 28.56M; 100 → 150 needs 8.33G (?.. wtf?); and Crumble level must be 350
We're on 1.4.002 now; this came out of the 1.5 range
